cases.title: Verify user does not have 2 overlapping reservations-positive-unsuccessful
cases.description: An user should have 2 reservations on same day
cases.preconditions: Users are assigned reservations in data seeder

steps.action: check that there are no 2 reservations on same day for the same user
steps.expected_result: each user has reservations on separate days
steps.data:
SELECT 
 r1.userid,
 r1.id as reservation1_id,
 r1.ReservationStartDate as res1_start,
 r1.ReservationEndDate as res1_end,
 r2.id as reservation2_id,
 r2.ReservationStartDate as res2_start,
 r2.ReservationEndDate as res2_end
FROM reservations r1
JOIN reservations r2 ON r1.userid = r2.userid AND r1.id < r2.id
JOIN users u ON r1.userid = u.id
WHERE u.isadmin = 0
 AND r1.ReservationStartDate < r2.ReservationEndDate
 AND r2.ReservationStartDate < r1.ReservationEndDate;

cases.title: Verify admin does not have more than 24 overlapping reservations(all on same day)-positive
cases.description: An admin can have at most 24 reservations on one day
cases.preconditions: Admins are assigned reservations when data is seeded

steps.action: check that there are no more than 24 reservations on the same day for the admin
steps.expected_result: Each admin should have less than 24 reservations on the same day
steps.data:
SELECT 
 u.id as admin_userid,
 CAST(r.ReservationStartDate AS DATE) as reservation_date,
 COUNT(\*) as reservations_count
FROM reservations r
JOIN users u ON r.userid = u.id
WHERE u.isadmin = 1
GROUP BY u.id, CAST(r.ReservationStartDate AS DATE)
HAVING COUNT(\*) > 24;

cases.title: Verify there are no more then 24 reservations on same day-positive
cases.description: On one day, there should be no more than 24 reservations
cases.preconditions: Reservations are seeded in the reservation table

steps.action: check that, for each day, there are no more than 24 reservations
steps.expected_result: on each day there are at most 24 reservations
steps.data:
SELECT 
 CAST(ReservationStartDate AS DATE) as reservation_date,
 COUNT(\*) as total_reservations
FROM reservations
GROUP BY CAST(ReservationStartDate AS DATE)
HAVING COUNT(\*) > 24;

cases.title: Verify some keys are assigned and some are not assigned-positive
cases.description: When data is seeded, some keys should be assigned correctly to users, some should not
cases.preconditions: Users and keys tables are seeded

steps.action: send a GET request to /api/keys and see that some keys are assigned and some are not
steps.expected_result: keys should be grouped by isAssigned==true and isAssigned==false
steps.data:
SELECT 
 COUNT(CASE WHEN CurrentHolderId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as assigned_keys,
 COUNT(CASE WHEN CurrentHolderId IS NULL THEN 1 END) as unassigned_keys
FROM keys;

cases.title: Verify SerialNumber has exactly 10 uppercase alfanumeric characters-positive
cases.description: The serial number for a key should have exactly 10 characters , that are alphanumeric
cases.preconditions: Key table is populated with data

steps.action: check that the serial number was imposed to have 10 alphanumeric characters
steps.expected_result: Each serial number respects this condition
steps.data:
SELECT 
 keyid,
 SerialNumber
FROM keys
WHERE LEN(SerialNumber) != 10 
 OR SerialNumber COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CS_AS != UPPER(SerialNumber)
 OR SerialNumber LIKE '%[^A-Z0-9]%';
